name: magellan-lite
description: Know what your change breaks before you commit it: the checklist where the damage lands, the verdict in the status bar, conflicts with your team's work in progress, and a map of what the change reaches. Python, Java, C, Fortran and COBOL. Nothing to install or set up.

commands.title: Share my work in progress with my team
Check against my team's work in progress

viewsWelcome.contents: Checking your change against the last commit...

Open a folder with Python code, and Magellan Lite checks your change every time you save.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

Magellan Lite runs on Python 3.10 or newer, and this computer doesn't have one yet. Install it (nothing else is needed: the extension brings the rest), then try again.
[Get Python](https://www.python.org/downloads/)
[Try again](command:magellanLite.check)

Magellan Lite could not run this time.
[Show what happened](command:magellanLite.showOutput)
[Try again](command:magellanLite.check)

Nothing to check in what your change touched. Edit and save a Python file to check it again.
[Show the map](command:magellanLite.showMap)
Nothing your change didn't edit is reached by it (or there is no change yet).

See what only your work and a teammate's break together, before either of you merges.
[Share my work in progress](command:magellanLite.share)
[Check against my team](command:magellanLite.team)
[Open the Team suite](command:magellanLite.openSuite)

magellanLite.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Leave empty: Magellan Lite finds a Python 3.10+ by itself (the one the Python extension selected, then `py`, `python3`, `python`) and brings its own engine, so nothing needs installing. Set a path only to force one interpreter.

magellanLite.checkOnSave.description: Check the change every time a Python file is saved.

magellanLite.against.description: What to compare the working tree with: git:REV, or a folder holding the old version.

magellanLite.showLow.description: Show low-severity findings (print() left in, == None, ...).

magellanLite.shareOnSave.markdownDescription: After you save a Python file, share your work in progress with your team (`magellan-lite share`: your working tree goes to `refs/wip/<your name>` on the git remote, at most once every 15 seconds), so your teammates' **Team suite** and `team` checks see it as you go. **Anyone who can read the repository can read it**: on a public repository, everyone.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Magellan Lite
walkthroughs.description: What your change breaks, before you commit it: in four steps.

steps.title: Save a change, see the verdict
steps.description:
Edit a function and save. Magellan Lite compares your work with the last commit: the verdict lands in the status bar, each finding on its line.
[Check this change now](command:magellanLite.check)

steps.title: Follow the change on the map
steps.description:
The map shows what you changed and every definition it reaches, hop by hop, even in files nobody opened.
[Show the map](command:magellanLite.showMap)

steps.title: Check against your team
steps.description:
Share your work in progress (no commit, no branch), and see what only your work plus a teammate's breaks.
[Share my work in progress](command:magellanLite.share)
[Check against my team](command:magellanLite.team)

steps.title: Watch the whole team live
steps.description:
The website's Team suite opens already connected to this repository. Turn on Share On Save and it follows your work as you go.
[Open the Team suite](command:magellanLite.openSuite)
[Turn on Share On Save](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22magellanLite.shareOnSave%22%5D)

scripts.package: node sync.js && node bundle.js && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --baseContentUrl https://github.com/Braxton-McMenamy/Magellan/blob/HEAD/editors/vscode --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/Braxton-McMenamy/Magellan/raw/HEAD/editors/vscode
